Readable original Menlo release reports the historical shares and identifies its survey population and investment in Anthropic.

evidence_items.locator: AI Infrastructure and Market Consolidation, Deedy Das quotation and preceding market-share paragraph

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI ceded nearly half its share.

evidence_items.explanation: Menlo reports Anthropic’s enterprise LLM API share rising from 12% in 2023 to 40% in 2025, while OpenAI’s fell from 50% to 27%. Both movements are substantial under the ordinary share-based reading.

Ramp independently reports rapid Anthropic adoption growth, but a small annual increase for OpenAI. Its adoption-rate denominator differs from enterprise API market share, so it limits a customer-loss interpretation rather than contradicting the selected share-based claim.

unresolved_gaps: No cited dataset measures the entire worldwide business AI market.
The evidence does not identify how many customers switched directly from OpenAI to Anthropic.
